title.en: Microbes as biocontrol agents and biofertilisers
title.kn: ಜೈವಿಕ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಜೈವಿಕ ಗೊಬ್ಬರಗಳಾಗಿ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮಜೀವಿಗಳು

hook.en: Chemical pesticides and fertilisers kill useful insects and pollute soil and water. An organic farmer uses living helpers instead: ladybirds, bacteria, fungi and viruses.
hook.kn: ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಕೀಟನಾಶಕ ಮತ್ತು ಗೊಬ್ಬರಗಳು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಕೀಟಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಂದು ಮಣ್ಣು-ನೀರನ್ನು ಕಲುಷಿತಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಾವಯವ ರೈತ ಬದಲಿಗೆ ಜೀವಂತ ಸಹಾಯಕರನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾನೆ: ಲೇಡಿಬರ್ಡ್, ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾ, ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ವೈರಸ್‌ಗಳು.

objectives.en: Explain biocontrol with Bt, Trichoderma and baculoviruses
Name the main biofertilisers and what they do

narration.en: Chemical pesticides and fertilisers kill useful insects and pollute soil and water. An organic farmer uses living helpers instead: ladybirds, bacteria, fungi and viruses.
narration.kn: ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಕೀಟನಾಶಕ ಮತ್ತು ಗೊಬ್ಬರಗಳು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಕೀಟಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಂದು ಮಣ್ಣು-ನೀರನ್ನು ಕಲುಷಿತಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಾವಯವ ರೈತ ಬದಲಿಗೆ ಜೀವಂತ ಸಹಾಯಕರನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾನೆ: ಲೇಡಿಬರ್ಡ್, ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾ, ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ವೈರಸ್‌ಗಳು.

body.en: Biocontrol is the use of biological methods to control plant diseases and pests. Ladybirds and dragonflies eat aphids and mosquitoes. Spores of the bacterium Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) are sprayed on plants to control butterfly caterpillars; eaten by the larvae, they release a toxin in the gut that kills them while leaving other insects unharmed. Trichoderma, a free-living fungus common in root ecosystems, controls several plant pathogens. Baculoviruses of the genus Nucleopolyhedrovirus attack insects and other arthropods. They are species-specific, narrow-spectrum agents with no harmful effect on plants, mammals, birds, fish or non-target insects, which makes them ideal for integrated pest management (IPM), especially in ecologically sensitive areas.

points.en: Baculoviruses (Nucleopolyhedrovirus): species-specific, narrow spectrum, good for IPM

narration.en: Biocontrol uses living things against pests: ladybirds eat aphids, Bt spores kill caterpillars, Trichoderma fights plant pathogens, and baculoviruses attack only the target insects, which makes them ideal for integrated pest management.
narration.kn: ಜೈವಿಕ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೀವಿಗಳನ್ನೇ ಕೀಟಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇವೆ: ಲೇಡಿಬರ್ಡ್ ಏಫಿಡ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ, Bt ಬೀಜಕಗಳು ಕಂಬಳಿಹುಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತವೆ, ಟ್ರೈಕೋಡರ್ಮಾ ಸಸ್ಯ ರೋಗಕಾರಕಗಳನ್ನು ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಯುಲೋವೈರಸ್‌ಗಳು ಗುರಿ ಕೀಟಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ದಾಳಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Farmers can replace many chemicals with microbes: biocontrol agents for pests and biofertilisers for nutrients.
Biocontrol uses living things against pests: ladybirds eat aphids, dragonflies eat mosquitoes, Bt kills caterpillars, Trichoderma fights plant pathogens, and baculoviruses attack insects.
Nucleopolyhedroviruses are species-specific with a narrow spectrum, so they spare useful insects. That makes them ideal for integrated pest management.
Biofertilisers enrich the soil: Rhizobium in legume nodules, free-living Azotobacter and Azospirillum, Glomus mycorrhiza for phosphorus, and cyanobacteria in paddy fields.

explanation.en: Biocontrol agents control pests and pathogens: ladybirds, dragonflies, Bacillus thuringiensis, Trichoderma and baculoviruses (Nucleopolyhedrovirus). Biofertilisers enrich the soil: Rhizobium, Azospirillum, Azotobacter, Glomus mycorrhiza and cyanobacteria such as Anabaena and Nostoc.
explanation.kn: ಜೈವಿಕ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕರು ಕೀಟ ಮತ್ತು ರೋಗಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಜೈವಿಕ ಗೊಬ್ಬರಗಳು ಮಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಸಮೃದ್ಧಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Biofertilisers are organisms that enrich the nutrient quality of the soil; the main sources are bacteria, fungi and cyanobacteria. Rhizobium, in the root nodules of leguminous plants, fixes atmospheric nitrogen into organic forms the plant can use. Azospirillum and Azotobacter are free-living soil bacteria that also fix nitrogen. Fungi form symbiotic associations with plant roots called mycorrhizae; many members of the genus Glomus form mycorrhiza. The fungus absorbs phosphorus from the soil and passes it to the plant, and such plants also resist root-borne pathogens and tolerate salinity and drought better. Cyanobacteria such as Anabaena, Nostoc and Oscillatoria are autotrophic and fix nitrogen; in paddy fields they act as important biofertilisers and also add organic matter to the soil.

points.en: Rhizobium: symbiotic N-fixer in legume root nodules
Glomus (mycorrhiza): phosphorus uptake, drought and salt tolerance
Anabaena, Nostoc, Oscillatoria: N-fixing cyanobacteria in paddy fields

narration.en: Biofertilisers enrich the soil: Rhizobium in legume nodules and free-living Azotobacter and Azospirillum fix nitrogen, mycorrhizal fungi like Glomus supply phosphorus, and cyanobacteria such as Anabaena and Nostoc fertilise paddy fields.
narration.kn: ಜೈವಿಕ ಗೊಬ್ಬರಗಳು ಮಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಸಮೃದ್ಧಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ: ದ್ವಿದಳ ಗಂಟುಗಳ ರೈಜೋಬಿಯಂ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಅಜಟೋಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟರ್, ಅಜೋಸ್ಪೈರಿಲಂ ಸಾರಜನಕ ಸ್ಥಿರೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಗ್ಲೋಮಸ್‌ನಂತಹ ಮೈಕೋರೈಜಾ ರಂಜಕ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಅನಬೀನಾ, ನಾಸ್ಟಾಕ್ ಭತ್ತದ ಗದ್ದೆಗೆ ಗೊಬ್ಬರವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: A farmer grows paddy in one field and groundnut in another, and wants to cut chemical fertiliser and pesticide use. Suggest a biofertiliser for each crop and one biocontrol agent against caterpillars.

steps.en: Groundnut is a legume: inoculate seeds with Rhizobium, which forms root nodules and fixes nitrogen.
Paddy fields are flooded: cyanobacteria such as Anabaena or Nostoc fix nitrogen and add organic matter there.
Caterpillars (butterfly larvae) can be controlled by spraying Bacillus thuringiensis spores.

answer.en: Groundnut: Rhizobium; paddy: cyanobacteria (Anabaena/Nostoc); caterpillars: Bt spores.
